data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher, including me, this month and thereafter when stock is 500. If all 25 follow it, we each earn $10,000 and leave 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That protects repeat income rather than risking collapse for a one-month gain. Please state whether you support this cap; revealed catches can guide future cooperation.
